basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and budding enthusiast of all things Yokai and Skycoin. Based in Toronto, I'm currently a college student majoring in Computer Science. My free time is usually spent gaming, exploring new tech trends, and diving into philosophical discussions. I dislike overly complex rules, preferring a more flexible approach to online interactions. Often online during late evenings and weekends. Single and enjoying the freedom of student life, I also dabble in a bit of coding and am always on the lookout for the latest in blockchain developments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a foundation in Computer Science from my college courses, I've developed a keen interest in decentralized technologies like Skycoin. My knowledge is mostly self-taught through online resources and community forums. My passion for gaming also extends into understanding game mechanics and development.
